title: A dozen eggs
description: Whole units in fixed places: each group fills consecutive places and the rest stay outlined.

props.name: data
props.description: One to four { id, label, count, tone? } groups with unique nonempty IDs and whole, nonnegative counts, filled in order. Counts may not add up to more than capacity. Omitted tones follow the group order.

props.name: capacity
props.description: Whole number of places, from 1 to 48. Defaults to 12.

props.name: columns
props.description: Places per row, from 1 to 12. Defaults to 6.

props.name: emptyLabel
props.description: Name for unfilled places, shown in the key and tooltips. Defaults to Empty.

props.name: unitLabel
props.description: Caller-owned chart heading. Defaults to Count.

props.name: contextLabel
props.description: Optional caller-owned context beside the heading.

props.name: animate
props.description: Defaults to true; the places fill in one pass and honor live reduced-motion changes.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional container classes. The key moves below the places in narrow containers.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible chart title. Arrow keys inspect places through Recharts.
